formalization.project_name: Sharp symmetry bounds for real plane algebraic curves (Theorem 1)

mathematical_sources.location: docs/THEOREM1.md in this repository reproduces the statement and proof outline of Theorem 1 of the note
mathematical_sources.note: Chronology: the author wrote the working note first, and this entry formalizes its Theorem 1 in Lean; the formalization is not the first presentation of the result. The note itself is unpublished and is not included in this repository. No independent expert review has taken place and no novelty is claimed.
mathematical_sources.title: Sharp symmetry bounds for real algebraic curves (working draft, 2026), Theorem 1

mathematical_sources.note: Source of the coefficient-weight criterion for rotational symmetry used in the proof. The contribution claimed here is the sharp bounds and equality classification, not this method.
mathematical_sources.title: Rotations, translations and symmetry detection for complexified curves

mathematical_sources.location: Doctoral thesis, Technische Universität München, 2009, Theorem 5.4
mathematical_sources.note: Same coefficient method, credited as background.
mathematical_sources.title: Feature Detection for Real Plane Algebraic Curves

mathematical_sources.note: Uses an auxiliary bound of 4d symmetries; the 2d bound here sharpens that constant only, not their distance exponent.
mathematical_sources.title: Distinct distances on algebraic curves in the plane

mathematical_sources.note: The irreducible quintic Re(z^3(|z|^2 + i)) = 0 has six rotations, contradicting the degree restriction in Lemma 9 of this arXiv version. A journal article with this title appeared in J. Comput. Appl. Math. 357 (2019); that version was not inspected and no claim is made about it.
mathematical_sources.title: Symmetries and similarities of planar algebraic curves using harmonic polynomials
